newsitem.title: USA: Moovies cuts expansion plan, sees charge.
newsitem.headline: Moovies cuts expansion plan, sees charge.

text.p: Moovies Inc will reduce the number of new stores to be developed this year from 80 to about 50 and will take a related one-time charge, Chairman, President and Chief Executive John Taylor said Tuesday.

He cited reduced profitability and related cash flows experienced for the year to date for the cut in expansion plans. The company had revenues of $26.6 million for the first quarter, compared to $19.3 million a year ago.
Taylor said, "The cost of implementing these reductions will result in a one-time charge to be recorded in the second quarter of approximately $1.5 million, or $0.07 per share."
Taylor said the steps "should enable Moovies to report more favorable financial results for the third and fourth quarters of 1997."
He also said Robert Klein, chief operating officer and a director, had left the company to pursue new business opportunities.
Moovies operates and franchises video specialty stores throughout the United States.
